exams.name: Board examination
exams.notes: Written, in English, covering anatomy, surgery, chemistry, biology, physics, physiology, pathology, obstetrics, gynecology, psychiatry, practice of medicine and hygiene. Applicants failing may have two reexaminations within two years.
exams.quote: Examinations shall be in whole or in part in writing, in English, shall be of a scientific and practical character, shall include the subjects of anatomy, surgery, chemistry, biology, physics, physiology, pathology, obstetrics, gynecology, psychiatry, practice of medicine and hygiene

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners certificate
exams.notes: Board may accept in lieu of its own professional examination at its discretion.
exams.quote: the board may at its discretion accept the certificate of the National Board of Medical Examiners of the United States, chartered under the laws of the District of Columbia, or the certificate of the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons of the American Osteopathic Association, in place of and as equivalent to its own professional examination

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) Steps 1, 2-CK, and 3
exams.notes: Required for the internationally-trained physician limited license pathway (Steps 1 and 2-CK for limited license; Step 3 for restricted/full license). Not required for standard domestic graduates.
exams.quote: has achieved a passing score on Step 1 and Step 2–Clinical Knowledge of the Licensing Exam

interval_years.quote: The board shall require that all physicians registered in the commonwealth renew their certificates of registration with the board at two year intervals.

required.quote: The board shall require that any continuing education requirements necessary for the renewal of a physician's certificate of registration include the 1–time completion of a course of training and education on the diagnosis, treatment and care of patients with cognitive impairments

value: 1-time course on diagnosis, treatment and care of patients with cognitive impairments (including Alzheimer's disease and dementia), applicable to physicians who serve adult populations
topical_requirements.quote: include the 1–time completion of a course of training and education on the diagnosis, treatment and care of patients with cognitive impairments, including, but not limited to, Alzheimer's disease and dementia; provided, however, that this course requirement shall only apply to physicians who serve adult populations

available.quote: The board may without examination grant certificates of registration as qualified physicians to such graduates of medical schools: (1) who shall furnish with their applications satisfactory proof that they have the qualifications required in the commonwealth to entitle them to be examined and have been licensed or registered upon a written examination in another state whose standards, in the opinion of the board, are equivalent to those in the commonwealth

requirements.value: Board may grant registration without examination to applicants licensed in another state with equivalent standards, or who are diplomates of AMA- or AOA-recognized specialty boards. Also available to graduates of Canadian medical schools licensed by the Medical Council of Canada and a provincial authority, or those scoring 75% or better on the federation licensing examination.
requirements.quote: The board may without examination grant certificates of registration as qualified physicians to such graduates of medical schools: (1) who shall furnish with their applications satisfactory proof that they have the qualifications required in the commonwealth to entitle them to be examined and have been licensed or registered upon a written examination in another state whose standards, in the opinion of the board, are equivalent to those in the commonwealth, or (2) who are diplomates of specialty boards recognized by the American Medical Association or the American Osteopathic Association

title_protection.quote: No person may, directly or indirectly, use the title ''physician'' or display or use the term physician in any title, advertisement, listing of affiliations, communication with the public or in any other manner to indicate or imply in any way that such person offers to engage or engages in the practice of medicine … who is not registered by the board of registration in medicine as a physician under section 2.

scope_protection.quote: whoever, not being lawfully authorized to practice medicine within the commonwealth and registered under section two … practices or attempts to practice medicine in any of its branches … shall be punished by a fine of not less than one hundred nor more than one thousand dollars or by imprisonment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently procured the certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraudulently procured said certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of an offense against any provision of the laws of the commonwealth relating to the practice of medicine, or any rule or regulation adopted thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of an offense against any provision of the laws of the commonwealth relating to the practice of medicine, or any rule or regulation adopted thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of conduct which places into question the physician's competence to practice medicine, including gross misconduct, fraudulent practice, practicing beyond authorized scope, gross incompetence, or negligence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of conduct which places into question the physician's competence to practice medicine, including but not limited to gross misconduct in the practice of medicine or of practicing medicine fraudulently, or beyond its authorized scope, or with gross incompetence, or with gross negligence on a particular occasion or negligence on repeated occasions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of practicing medicine while ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability or mental instability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of practicing medicine while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability or mental instability

disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of being habitually drunk or being or having been addicted to, dependent on, or a habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or other drugs having similar effects

disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of knowingly permitting, aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license for purposes of fraud, deception or personal gain

disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of violating any rule or regulation of the board, governing the practice of medicine

bonding_required.quote: The board is authorized to promulgate regulations requiring physicians to obtain professional malpractice liability insurance or a suitable bond or other indemnity against liability for professional malpractice in such amounts as may be determined by the board.

insurance_required.quote: The board is authorized to promulgate regulations requiring physicians to obtain professional malpractice liability insurance or a suitable bond or other indemnity against liability for professional malpractice in such amounts as may be determined by the board.

citations.kind: national board certificate in lieu of exam

definition_quote.value: Examinations shall be sufficiently thorough to test the applicants' fitness to practice medicine, covering anatomy, surgery, chemistry, biology, physics, physiology, pathology, obstetrics, gynecology, psychiatry, practice of medicine and hygiene.
definition_quote.quote: shall include the subjects of anatomy, surgery, chemistry, biology, physics, physiology, pathology, obstetrics, gynecology, psychiatry, practice of medicine and hygiene and shall be sufficiently thorough to test the applicants' fitness to practice medicine

methods_authorized.quote: The board shall make an annual report, including a statement of the condition of medicine and surgery in the commonwealth.

license_status_types.quote: the principal setting of their practice and whether they are an active or inactive practitioner

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must furnish documentary evidence that their education is substantially equivalent to US medical school graduates, and must present a Standard Certificate from the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG), unless granted an exemption by the board. Special pathways exist for certain Canadian-trained physicians and those scoring 75%+ on the federation licensing examination.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: An applicant who has received from a medical school, legally chartered in a sovereign state other than the United States, the commonwealth of Puerto Rico or Canada, a degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent shall be required to furnish to the board such documentary evidence as the board may require that his education is substantially the equivalent of that of graduates of medical schools in the United States and such other evidence as the board may require as to his qualifications to practice medicine, and shall, unless granted an exemption by the board, be required to present a Standard Certificate granted after examination by the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician licensed by the board may obtain proxy credentialing and privileging for telehealth services with other health care providers or facilities complying with CMS conditions of participation. Telehealth includes synchronous or asynchronous audio, video, electronic media, or other telecommunications technology for evaluating, diagnosing, consulting, prescribing, treating or monitoring patients.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: the board shall allow a physician licensed by the board to obtain proxy credentialing and privileging for telehealth services with other health care providers, as defined in section 1 of chapter 111, or facilities that comply with the federal Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services' conditions of participation for telehealth services

telemedicine_license_available.quote: the board shall allow a physician licensed by the board to obtain proxy credentialing and privileging for telehealth services with other health care providers

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any registered physician who does not possess professional liability insurance shall report to the board every settlement or arbitration award of a claim or action for damages for death or personal injury caused by negligence, error or omission in practice

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: a description of revocation or involuntary restriction of privileges by a hospital, clinic or nursing home under chapter 111, or of any employer who employs physicians licensed by the board for the purpose of engaging in the practice of medicine in the commonwealth, for reasons related to competence or character

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Whenever it appears that any physician licensed in the commonwealth may be incompetent or unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because such physician's ability to practice is impaired due to mental illness or physical illness, the board may order such physician to be examined by one or more physicians and surgeons designated by the board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: to a physician holding a license to practice in another state or territory or in the District of Columbia to permit him to act as a substitute physician for a registered physician in the commonwealth, to be granted only upon written request of said registered physician and to be limited to three months or less
